findings.message: The unreadable-PR table only uses a `pr_open` newest record. The previous finding asked for the `dispatched` record variant too, and it is still missing. The PR read has to come before the running check, because that order is the fix. No test pins it. The hand-merge-by-ancestry path with a newer dispatched/running record is also untested, although that is the other path the previous finding said the running check must not hide. Add the table rows: newest `dispatched`/`running` record with an older PR record whose body is `[]`, `{"x":1}`, a 500 or empty (expect `?`), and a newer `dispatched` record with `origin/<branch>` an ancestor of `origin/feature/<m>` (expect `merged`).
findings.scenario: Move the running check back above the PR read, or above the ancestry check. Records are [dispatched (newer), pr_open PR 21], and PR 21 returns FAIL500. The member reports `running` instead of `?`. A member whose branch was hand-merged, with a newer dispatched record, also reports `running` instead of `merged`. Every row in the new loops still passes.
